def normalize_session_id(value):
    if value is None or value == "":
        return str(uuid.uuid4())
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValidationError("A session_id mezőnek sztringnek kell lennie.")
    if not SESSION_ID_RE.fullmatch(value):
        raise ValidationError("Érvénytelen session_id formátum.")
    return value


def normalize_media_type(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValidationError("A kép media_type mezőjének sztringnek kell lennie.")
    normalized = CLIENT_MEDIA_NORMALIZATION.get(value.strip().lower())
    if not normalized:
        raise ValidationError("Nem támogatott kép media_type.")
    return normalized


def validate_message(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValidationError("A message mezőnek sztringnek kell lennie.")
    if len(value) > MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS:
        raise ValidationError("A message mező túl hosszú.")
    return value


def decode_and_validate_image(item):
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        raise ValidationError("Minden image elemnek objektumnak kell lennie.")
    if "data" not in item:
        raise ValidationError("Hiányzik az image.data mező.")
    if "media_type" not in item:
        raise ValidationError("Hiányzik az image.media_type mező.")
    data = item["data"]
    if not isinstance(data, str) or not data:
        raise ValidationError("Az image.data mezőnek nem üres base64 sztringnek kell lennie.")
    client_media_type = normalize_media_type(item["media_type"])
    try:
        raw = base64.b64decode(data, validate=True)
    except (binascii.Error, ValueError):
        raise ValidationError("Érvénytelen base64 képadat.")
    if not raw:
        raise ValidationError("Az image.data üres képadatot tartalmaz.")
    if len(raw) > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES:
        raise ValidationError("A kép túl nagy.")
    try:
        Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = 100000000
        probe = Image.open(io.BytesIO(raw))
        probe.verify()
        verified = Image.open(io.BytesIO(raw))
        verified.load()
        detected_media_type = PIL_TO_MEDIA_TYPE.get((verified.format or "").upper())
    except (UnidentifiedImageError, OSError, ValueError):
        raise ValidationError("Érvénytelen vagy nem támogatott képfájl.")
    if not detected_media_type:
        raise ValidationError("A kép formátuma nem támogatott.")
    if client_media_type != detected_media_type:
        raise ValidationError("A kép media_type mezője nem egyezik a tényleges képtípussal.")
    return {
        "raw_bytes": raw,
        "media_type": detected_media_type,
    }


def validate_images(value):
    if value is None:
        return []
    if not isinstance(value, list):
        raise ValidationError("Az images mezőnek listának kell lennie.")
    if len(value) > MAX_IMAGES:
        raise ValidationError("Túl sok kép lett küldve.")
    return [decode_and_validate_image(item) for item in value]


def parse_request_payload():
    if not request.is_json:
        raise ValidationError("A kérés Content-Type mezőjének application/json értékűnek kell lennie.")
    payload = request.get_json(silent=True)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValidationError("Érvénytelen JSON törzs.")
    session_id = normalize_session_id(payload.get("session_id"))
    message = validate_message(payload.get("message", ""))
    images = validate_images(payload.get("images", []))
    if not message and not images:
        raise ValidationError("A message vagy az images mező megadása kötelező.")
    return session_id, message, images


def error_response(message, status=400):
    return jsonify({"error": message}), status


def sanitize_lock_name(value):
    return re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", value)


@contextmanager
def session_request_lock(session_id):
    lock_path = LOCK_DIR / f"{sanitize_lock_name(session_id)}.lock"
    fd = os.open(lock_path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
    try:
        fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        yield
    finally:
        fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
        os.close(fd)


def ensure_session(conn, session_id):
    ts = now_ts()
    conn.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO sessions (session_id, preview, updated_at)
        VALUES (?, '', ?)
        ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO NOTHING
        """,
        (session_id, ts),
    )


def update_session_preview_and_touch(conn, session_id, content, has_image):
    ts = now_ts()
    preview_source = content if content else ("Kép" if has_image else "Chat")
    preview = preview_source[:80]
    conn.execute(
        """
        UPDATE sessions
        SET preview = CASE WHEN preview = '' THEN ? ELSE preview END,
            updated_at = ?
        WHERE session_id = ?
        """,
        (preview, ts, session_id),
    )


def insert_image_records(conn, images):
    image_keys = []
    ts = now_ts()
    for image in images:
        image_key = str(uuid.uuid4())
        conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO images (image_key, media_type, data, created_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
            """,
            (image_key, image["media_type"], sqlite3.Binary(image["raw_bytes"]), ts),
        )
        image_keys.append(image_key)
    return image_keys


def delete_images_by_keys(conn, image_keys):
    if not image_keys:
        return
    placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in image_keys)
    conn.execute(f"DELETE FROM images WHERE image_key IN ({placeholders})", image_keys)


def purge_orphan_images(conn):
    conn.execute(
        """
        DELETE FROM images
        WHERE image_key NOT IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT image_key FROM message_images
        )
        """
    )


def insert_message(conn, session_id, role, content, has_image=False, image_keys=None, vision_context="", status="complete"):
    ensure_session(conn, session_id)
    ts = now_ts()
    cursor = conn.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO messages (session_id, role, content, has_image, vision_context, ts, status)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        """,
        (session_id, role, content, 1 if has_image else 0, vision_context or "", ts, status),
    )
    message_id = cursor.lastrowid
    for image_key in image_keys or []:
        conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO message_images (message_id, image_key)
            VALUES (?, ?)
            """,
            (message_id, image_key),
        )
    update_session_preview_and_touch(conn, session_id, content, has_image)
    return message_id


def update_message(conn, message_id, content, status):
    conn.execute(
        """
        UPDATE messages
        SET content = ?, status = ?, ts = ?
        WHERE id = ?
        """,
        (content, status, now_ts(), message_id),
    )


def delete_message(conn, message_id):
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM messages WHERE id = ?", (message_id,))


def session_exists(conn, session_id):
    row = conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?", (session_id,)).fetchone()
    return row is not None


def fetch_messages(conn, session_id):
    rows = conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT id, role, content, has_image, vision_context, ts, status
        FROM messages
        WHERE session_id = ?
        ORDER BY id ASC
        """,
        (session_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    if rows is None:
        return []
    image_rows = conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT mi.message_id, mi.image_key
        FROM message_images mi
        JOIN messages m ON m.id = mi.message_id
        WHERE m.session_id = ?
        ORDER BY mi.message_id ASC, mi.image_key ASC
        """,
        (session_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    image_map = {}
    for row in image_rows:
        image_map.setdefault(row["message_id"], []).append(row["image_key"])
    messages = []
    for row in rows:
        messages.append(
            {
                "id": row["id"],
                "role": row["role"],
                "content": row["content"],
                "has_image": bool(row["has_image"]),
                "image_keys": list(image_map.get(row["id"], [])),
                "vision_context": row["vision_context"] or "",
                "ts": row["ts"],
                "status": row["status"],
            }
        )
    return messages


def build_cerebras_messages(history, raw_message, vision_context):
    result = [{"role": "system", "content": GLM_SYSTEM}]
    for msg in history:
        role = msg["role"]
        if role not in ("user", "assistant"):
            continue
        content = msg["content"] or ""
        if role == "user" and msg.get("vision_context"):
            if content:
                content = f"{content}\n\n[IMAGE CONTEXT]\n{msg['vision_context']}\n[/IMAGE CONTEXT]"
            else:
                content = f"[IMAGE CONTEXT]\n{msg['vision_context']}\n[/IMAGE CONTEXT]"
        if role == "assistant" and not content:
            continue
        result.append({"role": role, "content": content})
    user_content = raw_message or ""
    if vision_context:
        if user_content:
            user_content = f"{user_content}\n\n[IMAGE CONTEXT]\n{vision_context}\n[/IMAGE CONTEXT]"
        else:
            user_content = f"[IMAGE CONTEXT]\n{vision_context}\n[/IMAGE CONTEXT]"
    result.append({"role": "user", "content": user_content})
    return result


def analyze_images(raw_message, images, emit, stop_event):
    gemini_client = get_gemini_client()
    parts = []
    for image in images:
        parts.append(
            types.Part(
                inline_data=types.Blob(
                    mime_type=image["media_type"],
                    data=image["raw_bytes"],
                )
            )
        )
    question_hint = f' The user is asking: "{raw_message}"' if raw_message else ""
    parts.append(types.Part.from_text(text=f"Describe this image briefly and naturally.{question_hint}"))
    contents = [types.Content(role="user", parts=parts)]
    config = types.GenerateContentConfig(
        max_output_tokens=512,
        system_instruction=[types.Part.from_text(text=GEMINI_VISION_SYSTEM)],
    )
    emit({"type": "image_analysis_start"})
    vision_context = ""
    try:
        for chunk in gemini_client.models.generate_content_stream(
            model=GEMINI_MODEL,
            contents=contents,
            config=config,
        ):
            if stop_event.is_set():
                raise RuntimeError("A stream megszakadt.")
            text = getattr(chunk, "text", None) or ""
            if text:
                vision_context += text
                emit({"type": "image_analysis", "text": text})
    except Exception:
        emit({"type": "image_analysis_end"})
        raise
    emit({"type": "image_analysis_end"})
    cleaned = vision_context.strip()
    if not cleaned:
        raise RuntimeError("A képelemzés nem adott vissza használható eredményt.")
    return cleaned


def run_chat_worker(session_id, raw_message, images, emit, stop_event):
    image_keys = []
    assistant_message_id = None
    full_response = ""
    reasoning_started = False
    content_started = False
    try:
        with session_request_lock(session_id):
            with get_db() as conn:
                history = fetch_messages(conn, session_id)
                image_keys = insert_image_records(conn, images) if images else []
            vision_context = ""
            if images:
                try:
                    vision_context = analyze_images(raw_message, images, emit, stop_event)
                except Exception as exc:
                    with get_db() as conn:
                        delete_images_by_keys(conn, image_keys)
                        purge_orphan_images(conn)
                    emit({"type": "error", "message": "Kép elemzés sikertelen: " + str(exc)})
                    return
            with get_db() as conn:
                insert_message(
                    conn,
                    session_id,
                    "user",
                    raw_message or "",
                    has_image=bool(image_keys),
                    image_keys=image_keys,
                    vision_context=vision_context,
                    status="complete",
                )
                assistant_message_id = insert_message(
                    conn,
                    session_id,
                    "assistant",
                    "",
                    has_image=False,
                    image_keys=[],
                    vision_context="",
                    status="streaming",
                )
            cerebras_messages = build_cerebras_messages(history, raw_message, vision_context)
            cerebras_client = get_cerebras_client()
            stream = cerebras_client.chat.completions.create(
                model=CEREBRAS_MODEL,
                messages=cerebras_messages,
                stream=True,
                max_completion_tokens=16000,
                temperature=1,
                top_p=0.95,
                clear_thinking=False,
            )
            for chunk in stream:
                if stop_event.is_set():
                    break
                choices = getattr(chunk, "choices", None) or []
                if not choices:
                    continue
                delta = getattr(choices[0], "delta", None)
                if delta is None:
                    continue
                reasoning = getattr(delta, "reasoning", None) or ""
                content = getattr(delta, "content", None) or ""
                if reasoning and not content_started:
                    if not reasoning_started:
                        reasoning_started = True
                        emit({"type": "reasoning_start"})
                    emit({"type": "reasoning", "text": reasoning})
                if content:
                    if reasoning_started:
                        reasoning_started = False
                        emit({"type": "reasoning_end"})
                    content_started = True
                    full_response += content
                    emit({"type": "content", "text": content})
            if reasoning_started:
                emit({"type": "reasoning_end"})
                reasoning_started = False
            with get_db() as conn:
                if assistant_message_id is not None:
                    if full_response:
                        update_message(conn, assistant_message_id, full_response, "partial" if stop_event.is_set() else "complete")
                    else:
                        delete_message(conn, assistant_message_id)
                update_session_preview_and_touch(conn, session_id, raw_message or "", bool(image_keys))
    except Exception as exc:
        if reasoning_started:
            emit({"type": "reasoning_end"})
        with get_db() as conn:
            if assistant_message_id is not None:
                if full_response:
                    update_message(conn, assistant_message_id, full_response, "error")
                else:
                    delete_message(conn, assistant_message_id)
        emit({"type": "error", "message": "Szerverhiba: " + str(exc)})
    finally:
        emit({"type": "done"})


def make_streaming_response(session_id, raw_message, images):
    event_queue = queue.Queue()
    stop_event = threading.Event()

    def emit(payload):
        if not stop_event.is_set():
            event_queue.put(sse(payload))

    def worker():
        try:
            run_chat_worker(session_id, raw_message, images, emit, stop_event)
        finally:
            event_queue.put(None)

    thread = threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True)

    def generate():
        yield f"retry: {SSE_RETRY_MS}\n\n"
        yield sse({"type": "session", "session_id": session_id})
        thread.start()
        try:
            while True:
                try:
                    item = event_queue.get(timeout=HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL)
                except queue.Empty:
                    if not thread.is_alive():
                        break
                    yield sse_comment("keep-alive")
                    continue
                if item is None:
                    break
                yield item
        except GeneratorExit:
            stop_event.set()
            raise
        finally:
            stop_event.set()
            thread.join(timeout=2)

    return Response(
        stream_with_context(generate()),
        mimetype="text/event-stream",
        headers={
            "Cache-Control": "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate",
            "Pragma": "no-cache",
            "X-Accel-Buffering": "no",
            "Connection": "keep-alive",
        },
    )


@app.after_request

    response.headers.setdefault("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
    response.headers.setdefault("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer")
    return response


@app.route("/")
def index():
    return send_file(BASE_DIR / "index.html")


@app.route("/api/sessions", methods=["GET"])
def list_sessions():
    with get_db() as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            """
            SELECT s.session_id, s.preview, s.updated_at, COUNT(m.id) AS count
            FROM sessions s
            LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.session_id = s.session_id
            GROUP BY s.session_id, s.preview, s.updated_at
            ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC
            """
        ).fetchall()
    return jsonify(
        {
            "sessions": [
                {
                    "session_id": row["session_id"],
                    "preview": row["preview"] or "Chat",
                    "count": row["count"],
                    "updated_at": row["updated_at"],
                }
                for row in rows
            ]
        }
    )


@app.route("/api/session/<session_id>", methods=["GET"])
def get_session_messages(session_id):
    if not SESSION_ID_RE.fullmatch(session_id):
        return error_response("Érvénytelen session_id formátum.", 400)
    with get_db() as conn:
        if not session_exists(conn, session_id):
            return jsonify({"messages": []}), 404
        messages = fetch_messages(conn, session_id)
    return jsonify(
        {
            "messages": [
                {
                    "role": msg["role"],
                    "content": msg["content"],
                    "has_image": msg["has_image"],
                    "image_keys": msg["image_keys"],
                    "ts": msg["ts"],
                    "status": msg["status"],
                }
                for msg in messages
            ]
        }
    )


@app.route("/api/image/<image_key>", methods=["GET"])
def get_image(image_key):
    if not IMAGE_KEY_RE.fullmatch(image_key):
        return error_response("Érvénytelen image_key formátum.", 400)
    with get_db() as conn:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT media_type, data FROM images WHERE image_key = ?",
            (image_key,),
        ).fetchone()

        return jsonify({"error": "not found"}), 404

        mimetype=row["media_type"],
        headers={

            "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff",
        },
    )

@app.route("/api/history", methods=["DELETE"])
def delete_history():
    session_id = request.args.get("session_id", "", type=str)
    if not session_id:
        return error_response("Hiányzik a session_id paraméter.", 400)
    if not SESSION_ID_RE.fullmatch(session_id):
        return error_response("Érvénytelen session_id formátum.", 400)
    with session_request_lock(session_id):
        with get_db() as conn:
            if not session_exists(conn, session_id):
                return jsonify({"ok": True}), 404
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?", (session_id,))
            purge_orphan_images(conn)
    return jsonify({"ok": True})

def chat():
    try:
        session_id, raw_message, images = parse_request_payload()
    except ValidationError as exc:
        return error_response(str(exc), 400)
    return make_streaming_response(session_id, raw_message, images)
